result.document_summary: Massachusetts G.L. c. 151B § 4 (part 1 of 2), listing unlawful discriminatory practices in employment, housing, credit and related areas, including the bar on discrimination against recipients of public assistance and housing subsidies in rentals.
result.notes: Most of section 4 concerns employment, credit, commercial space and protected-class housing discrimination, which are outside the six categories. Only subsection 10 is in scope: it bars discrimination against rental applicants/tenants based on public assistance or housing subsidies (source-of-income screening restriction). Subsection 9 (criminal record inquiries) is limited to employment and is not extracted. No effective date is stated in this section text.

rules.title: Source-of-income / housing subsidy discrimination ban in rental accommodations
rules.requirement: It is an unlawful practice for any person furnishing rental accommodations to discriminate against an individual because the individual receives federal, state or local public assistance, or is a tenant receiving housing subsidies such as rental assistance or rental supplements, or because of any requirement of such programs.
rules.key_value: No discrimination against public assistance or housing subsidy recipients (including rental assistance)
rules.quoted_span: For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance, or who is a tenant receiving federal, state, or local housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements
rules.coverage_text: Applies to any person furnishing rental accommodations, with no stated building-based limits in this subsection.
